local.animo: Previa Flashscore: Schalke’s 2-1 defeat to Hoffenheim before the international break extended their winless run to seven competitive matches (D2, L5) and kept them in the relegation zone with just six points, the same tally that the Royal Blues had after nine matches of their relegation-bound campaign in 2022/23. Head coach Miron Muslić is under pressure to move his side away from the danger zone and bring some long-awaited joy to the home supporters, who haven't seen their side score in four consecutive Bundesliga home outings. Exte Bajas según Flashscore: Becker T. (Foot Injury), Schallenberg R. (Leg Injury), Wober M. (Muscle Injury).
